newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Savings on core projects lower cost of HK airport.
newsitem.headline: Savings on core projects lower cost of HK airport.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Monday the budget for the new Chek Lap Kok airport had been reduced due to savings on three of seven government core projects.
The overall cost estimate for the Airport Core Programme (ACP) now stood at HK$156.36 billion against the previous HK$158.17 billion, it said.

"As a result of rigorous control over costs and a small reduction in scope of the ACP, the government has achieved considerable savings from the Lantau Link, Route 3 and the West Kowloon Reclamation projects," it said in a statement.
The airport and airport railway would be completed in April and June 1998, respectively, the statement said.
